name: AMBIGUOUS
message: More than one resource matches
doc: The reference matched several resources; the response lists the candidates.

name: AUTH_EXPIRED
message: Your session has expired
doc: The session token is expired or was revoked. Sign in again, then retry.

name: AUTH_REQUIRED
message: You are not signed in
doc: No session was presented. Sign in, then retry.

name: CANCELLED
message: Cancelled
doc: The person cancelled at a prompt or with Ctrl+C. Cancelling is not a failure; nothing further ran.

name: CLIENT_TOO_OLD
message: This version of the Beaver CLI is too old
doc: The server needs a newer CLI than the one making the request; update the CLI.

name: CLOUD_MACHINE_INELIGIBLE
message: Machine cannot join this cloud
doc: One or more requirements for joining a cloud are not met. Each requirement is listed with its status and repair.

name: CONFLICT
message: The request conflicts with an existing resource
doc: Another resource conflicts with this request; the response names it and a safe resolution.

name: CONTEXT_UNRESOLVED
message: Beaver could not work out which workspace or project you mean
doc: No workspace, project or environment could be resolved from the flag, environment, config or default. The response shows each source consulted.

name: FLAG_CONFLICT
message: Flags cannot be used together
doc: Two flags that exclude each other were given.

name: FLAG_IGNORED
message: A flag has no effect on this command
doc: The flag is not supported by this command and would have been silently ignored.

name: FLAG_INVALID_VALUE
message: A flag or argument has an invalid value
doc: A flag value is outside the accepted values or format. The response lists the accepted values and a corrected command.

name: FLAG_REQUIRES
message: A flag needs another flag
doc: A flag was given without the flag it depends on.

name: FORBIDDEN
message: You are not allowed to do this
doc: The caller is signed in but not permitted to perform the operation. A response that can name the missing capability uses FORBIDDEN_CAPABILITY instead.

name: FORBIDDEN_CAPABILITY
message: Your workspace is missing a required capability
doc: The acting workspace or user lacks a capability the operation needs; the response names it and the role that can grant it.

name: INTERNAL
message: Beaver could not complete the operation
doc: An unexpected failure. Quote the request id when reporting it.

name: INVALID_REQUEST
message: The request was not valid
doc: The server rejected the request as malformed or invalid; the message says which part.

name: LOCAL_PREREQUISITE
message: Something this machine needs is missing
doc: A local prerequisite (writable directory, git repository, reachable Docker, parseable config file) is not met. Raised before any request is sent.

name: MAINTENANCE
message: Beaver is in maintenance
doc: The platform is in a maintenance window. The response gives the window and the status page.

name: MFA_REQUIRED
message: This workspace requires 2-step verification
doc: The workspace enforces 2-step verification and the account has none.

name: NETWORK_DNS
message: The server's name could not be resolved
doc: DNS resolution of the server's host name failed.

name: NETWORK_PROXY
message: A proxy blocked the request
doc: A configured HTTP proxy refused or failed the request (for example proxy authentication).

name: NETWORK_TIMEOUT
message: The server did not answer in time
doc: No response arrived before the deadline. A mutating request may have been applied anyway.

name: NETWORK_TLS
message: The server's certificate could not be verified
doc: The TLS handshake failed: untrusted or expired certificate, wrong host name, or a wrong system clock.

name: NETWORK_UNREACHABLE
message: The Beaver server could not be reached
doc: The connection to the server failed before any response arrived (refused, reset, unreachable network).

name: NOT_FOUND
message: Resource not found
doc: No such resource exists in the scope the caller can see.

name: OPERATION_FAILED
message: The operation failed
doc: An operation failed after it started; the response names the failed stage and what changed.

name: PRECONDITION_FAILED
message: Prerequisites for this operation are not met
doc: One or more prerequisites are unmet; each is listed as a condition with its repair.

name: QUOTA_EXCEEDED
message: A plan or quota limit was reached
doc: Current use has reached the limit; the response gives use, limit and options.

name: RATE_LIMITED
message: Too many requests
doc: The caller is being rate limited; retry after the stated delay.

name: STATE_INVALID
message: The resource is not in a state that allows this
doc: The resource's current state does not permit the operation; the response gives the current and required state and the transition.

name: STEP_UP_REQUIRED
message: This action needs a fresh second-factor confirmation
doc: A sensitive action needs a single-use confirmation from a second factor. The response names the action scope and how to satisfy it.

name: TEMPORARY
message: A temporary condition blocked the request
doc: A transient condition (rate limit, maintenance, overload) blocked the request; retry later.
